text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae! Go, Tarumae!! Wait, what?! 
Whaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!! Just unbelievable!! Pushing 
past the formidable dirt field!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey crosses the line in first!! 
Her very first GⅠ victory—!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, kuuaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonnnn!! Overcoming every hardship, 
trial, and tribulation—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Behold the power of feng shui☆ How do you 
like that?! Did you see that?!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Who won? Huh...? What's a Copano 
Rickey...?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The power of feng shui... Are you 
serious...? I was skeptical during all 
that fuss last summer, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, weren't there people 
predicting she wasn't in great shape? Can 
feng shui really overturn that too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire venue was buzzing. Stunned by 
such a commanding first GI victory from a 
rising star who had only just entered the 
Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah... Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey rushed straight over to 
Hokko Tarumae. To the one person she 
desperately wanted to talk to.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you understand a bit better 
now. No, not about Feng Shui, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That I'm running seriously, in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae might not believe in feng shui. 
And there might be others who don't 
believe in it, just like her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I've seen it with my own eyes, you 
know. People who were saved by the 
encouragement of feng shui."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Cheering someone up just a little with 
feng shui. Giving their heart a breath of 
fresh air. That's..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
To me, it's something incredibly 
important. So much so that I'd gladly 
dedicate my whole life to it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to share feng shui. For 
those who've lost their way on life's dark 
path and feel totally helpless on their 
own.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If they only knew about feng shui, they 
could get back on their feet. For the sake 
of someone like that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect everyone to believe me. Not 
even Tarumae. Even so—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I believe in this! I know it's something 
truly important!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I... believe... I... believe in you...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes... Rickey is...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You believe in it too, don't you...? Just 
like I do.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Just like me... Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae pressed her lips together 
tightly, as if recalling something. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because I've met plenty of people who 
didn't understand how I felt, either.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I say I want to do my 
best for Tomakomai, they tell me, "There's 
no point in that. In the end, it's an 
individual sport."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I couldn't bring myself to think 
that way. I can't run like that...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond victory, I'm sure there lies 
happiness for everyone back home. That's 
what I believe. So..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Watching Ricky run today made me realize 
it. Ricky feels the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if what we believe in is different, 
she's completely serious about it. I don't 
really get feng shui myself, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I acknowledge you, Rickey. Because you 
deserve to be recognized—no, I want to 
recognize you from the bottom of my heart, 
as an amazing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two looked at each other and nodded in 
silent understanding. With that, their 
misunderstanding was finally resolved. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By acknowledging each other, the curtain 
rises on a new relationship. The curtain 
rises on the Senior year, the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae. I don't think things are settled 
between us after today. Nor with 
Acute-san. So—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next is the closest Dirt GⅠ! Uh, 
meaning...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: May's Kashiwa Kinen! That's where!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen... The race at Funabashi 
that I won last year...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'll welcome me as the reigning 
champion, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see. Rickey is entering. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll pass on participating after 
all~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ehh, why~?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. Heheh, I'm not backing 
out just because Rickey is running. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race made me realize something. 
At this rate, I might not be able to keep 
beating Rickey."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky is definitely going to keep getting 
stronger and stronger. If so, then I have 
to...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I need to work even harder than last year! 
So I might not enter the Kashiwa Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Work even harder... than last year? Then 
Tarumae, where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae didn't answer. She merely 
gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Trainer, my next goal can be the 
Kashiwa Kinen, right?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's the best option.
Yeah, I think that's the best option.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by her performance in today's 
race, moving through the GⅠ circuit won't 
be a problem at all. No matter how Hokko 
Tarumae decides to make her move."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wonder what Tarumae is planning 
to do. She said she'd work even harder 
than last year, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any other GⅠ races held at 
the exact same time, right? There 
shouldn't be another path to take.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A mystery certainly remains. What did 
Hokko Tarumae feel today, and what did she 
decide?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The tangle of emotions between Tarumae and 
me has finally been resolved. That's a 
good thing, but still—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a new chain of causality has 
started moving because of this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because by acknowledging me, it 
seems Tarumae has entered a whole new 
cycle.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The flow of qi improved. If anything, it 
improved too much. Which is precisely 
why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, while prepping for the Kashiwa 
Kinen, maybe you should keep an eye out. 
On how the whole planet—will shift from 
here on.
